# Spendflo

> Spendflo is an AI-native procurement platform that automates spend management, vendor governance, and contract lifecycle processes for enterprises.

Spendflo provides end-to-end procurement automation with conversational AI, real-time pricing benchmarks, and integrated vendor management. The platform serves finance, procurement, legal, IT, and risk & compliance teams with unified spend visibility and governance controls.

## Key Topics

- AI-native procurement
- Spend management
- Contract management
- Vendor management
- Workflow automation
- Intake-to-procure
- Third-party risk management
- SaaS optimization
- Pricing benchmarks
- Vendor onboarding
- PO management
- Conversational AI
- Compliance & governance
- ERP integration
- License optimization

## Core Platform

- [Spendflo | Effortless AI-Native Procurement Platform](https://www.spendflo.com): Spendflo AI-native procurement platform for spend management and governance
- [AI-Native Intake-to-Procure Software | Automated Procurement | Spendflo](https://www.spendflo.com/intake-to-procure): Automate procurement lifecycle with AI-native intake and workflow automation
- [AI-Powered Procurement Intake & Workflow Automation | Spendflo](https://www.spendflo.com/intake-management): AI-powered procurement intake with conversational interface and approvals
- [AI-Native Procurement Workflow Orchestration | Spendflo](https://www.spendflo.com/workflows): Procurement workflow orchestration with no-code builder and integrations
- [AI Conversational Workflow Builder | Create Workflows with Chat | Spendflo](https://www.spendflo.com/conversational-workflow-builder): AI conversational workflow builder for procurement automation via chat

## Procurement & Vendor Management

- [Vendor Onboarding Software | Automate Compliance & Approvals | Spendflo](https://www.spendflo.com/vendor-onboarding): Vendor onboarding automation with compliance and risk assessment workflows
- [AI-Native Supplier Management & SaaS Centralization | Spendflo](https://www.spendflo.com/supplier-management): Supplier management and SaaS centralization with spend visibility
- [PO Management Software | Centralize & Automate | Spendflo](https://www.spendflo.com/po-management): PO management software for centralized procurement and audit compliance
- [Automated Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) | Spendflo](https://www.spendflo.com/third-party-risk-assessment): Automated TPRM and vendor security assessment with compliance tracking

## Spend Intelligence & Analytics

- [SaaS Pricing Benchmarks & Data-Driven Leverage | Spendflo](https://www.spendflo.com/pricing-benchmarks): SaaS pricing benchmarks with 10,000+ real-time data for negotiations
- [Usage Analytics](https://www.spendflo.com/usage-analytics): Usage analytics for SaaS license optimization and shadow IT detection
- [Conversational Reporting | Ask Questions, Get Answers](https://www.spendflo.com/conversational-reporting): Conversational AI reporting for instant contract and spend insights
- [Managed Procurement Capacity & Pricing Benchmarks | Spendflo](https://www.spendflo.com/managed-services): Managed procurement services with pricing benchmarks and vendor negotiations
